description.narrative: The initiative “Women Leading Green Livelihoods from Water Lilies Linked to Ecological Conservation in the Buffer Zone of the Cham Islands, Hoi An World Biosphere Reserve” is implemented in Phuoc Trung Hamlet, Hoi An Ward, Da Nang City, with a proposed duration of 18 months. The initiative aims to establish a women-led green livelihood model based on water lily cultivation and a circular value chain, linked to ecological conservation, environmental education, and community-based learning tourism. The overall objective is to transform local livelihoods through water lily cultivation connected to ecosystem conservation, promotion of natural resources and indigenous knowledge, and the development of community-based learning tourism, thereby enhancing women’s roles in green economic development. Specific objectives include: providing training and empowerment for local communities especially middle-aged women to participate in the water lily value chain (production, processing, and commercialization) and integrate products into learning tourism; introducing freeze-dried water lily flowers into Da Nang’s OCOP (One Commune One Product) system, restoring and expanding water lily cultivation on approximately 2 hectares, and establishing local nursery and propagation capacity; and promoting water lily-based products through tourism itineraries in Hoi An Ward and Da Nang City and piloting community-based learning and research tours centered on the water lily landscape model. Expected results include improved community awareness of the ecological and economic values ofwater lilies, strengthened participation in conservation-linked livelihood activities, and establishment of a community self-management group led by local mass organizations and cooperative actors. In addition, the initiative supports processing and administrative steps for an OCOP-certified freeze-dried water lily product, provides key infrastructure such as a freeze-drying machine, and promotes women’s digital sales skills through online competitions and marketing activities. The University of Danang, University of Science and Education (UED) serves as the lead implementing agency, collaborating with relevant local stakeholders to ensure coordination, capacity building, and sustainability of outcomes beyond the project period. The budget planning period stated in the proposal isfrom October 2025 to April 2027 (18 months).

participating-org.narrative: The University of Danang, University of Science and Education (UED), formerly the Teacher Training College of Quang Nam-Da Nang, has a history of more than 50 years of development. As a member of the University of Danang system, UED serves as a key hub for teacher education, scientific research training, and technology transfer in Vietnam’s Central region. UED offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Natural Sciences, Social Sciences and Humanities, Educational Psychology, and Information Technology. The university also maintains strong international partnerships with institutions worldwide to enhance the quality of education and strengthen research capacity.
